rows: A friend: “Night train? I bet you didn't sleep a wink.” (You slept for eight hours.)
It was a lot more comfortable than you'd think — I slept for eight hours.
A colleague: “Learning to drive at forty? That must have been a nightmare.” (You passed first time.)
It was a lot easier than you'd think — I passed first time.
note: or: It wasn't as hard as you'd think. · not 'more easier'

rows: Your neighbour: “A week in Switzerland? That must have cost a fortune.” (You stayed with friends and cooked your own meals.)
It was a lot cheaper than you'd think — we stayed with friends.
A friend: “Renewing your passport? That must have been a nightmare.” (It took twenty minutes online.)
It was a lot simpler than you'd think — it only took twenty minutes online.
A friend: “Teenagers never talk to their parents.” (Your son tells you everything — usually at midnight.)
Mine's a lot chattier than you'd think — he tells me everything. Usually at midnight.
note: or: a lot more talkative · chatty → chattier

rows: A friend: “IKEA furniture? I bet that took you all weekend.” (It took you an hour. One screw was left over.)
It was a lot quicker than you'd think — it took me an hour. Only one screw left over!
